description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC REST controller named CustomerRESTController, which provides endpoints for managing customer-related operations in a sales management application. Functionalities include retrieving customer details, creating and deleting customers, and managing customer options and attribute values. The controller interacts with various services for handling the business logic and uses utility classes for email notifications and localization.

classes.name: CustomerRESTController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that exposes RESTful endpoints for customer management, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting customers, along with managing customer options and option values.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a customer's details by ID for a specific store, returning a readable customer DTO.

methods.name: createCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Creates a new customer option value and saves it to the database.

methods.name: createCustomerOption
methods.description: Creates a new customer option and saves it.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by ID from a specific store.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer for a specified store, assigns default roles, encodes password, and sends registration email.
